notes: resize_fixtures sources are LCG-noise RGB images: state = (state * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2**31 starting from lcg_seed, each source byte = (state >> 16) & 0xFF in HWC order.

Vision tensors (vision_model.*, sam_model.*, image_newline, view_separator) are stored RAW BF16 (unquantized); only projector.layers is 4-bit affine (group 64) — see safetensors header survey in the WS-07a report.
Stage tensors are token-flattened [L, C] f32 row samples (channels complete); final features are full bf16 bits.
